<div class="card-body">
'''AT-AT Driver''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ＡＴ－ＡＴドライバー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する戦闘用ビークルの戦闘力に２を加える。戦闘用ビークルがＡＴ－ＡＴなら２ではなく３を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-AT-AT-Driver-SWCA-100667.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">戦場を遥かに見下ろしつつウォーカーを駆るＡＴ－ＡＴドライバーたちは、厚さ15cmの強化装甲板で護られているため、歩兵たちからは臆病者と軽蔑されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' AT-AT Driver.

'''Card text:'''
Add 2 to the power of any combat vehicle this character pilots. If the combat vehicle is an AT-AT, add 3 instead of 2.

'''Lore:'''
AT-AT drivers pilot their walkers high above the battlefield. The infantry scorn them as cowards because 15 centimeters of reinforced armor protect them.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore explicitly says the infantry regard the drivers as cowards.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[AT-AT Driver]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
